name: herdr
description: herdr workspace/tab/pane orchestration for visible Claude Code + Codex worker panes. Prefers subagent/lightweight delegation first; opens a new herdr pane only when a visible TUI, separate CLI/account/browser state, or an explicit pane fan-out is needed (v0.10 routing gate). Tunes worker model/effort by difficulty (latest-model check) with ultracode/goalcraft/goal support.

interface.longDescription: Use herdr to create isolated workspaces, split panes, spawn Claude Code or Codex workers, inject prompts, wait for agent status, and collect verification output. v0.5 adds difficulty-based autonomous tuning of each worker's model and effort (with a runtime latest-model check, no stale hardcoding), ultracode (Claude Code setting = xhigh + auto Workflow orchestration, 2-level fan-out), and goalcraft/goal usage. v0.10 adds a routing gate that prefers subagents/lightweight delegation and only opens herdr panes when a visible TUI, separate CLI/account/browser state, or an explicit pane fan-out is required.
defaultPrompt: Open a herdr worker pane for verification.
Read the output from a herdr pane.
